findings.summary: The deliberate choice that an empty allowlist is fingerprint-identity-neutral remains consistent with ADR-017 and the 12.1 scope boundary.
findings.detail: Re-confirmed unchanged: RendererConfigurationFingerprint.AppendAllowedValues returns early for an empty list, so the default configuration fingerprint is byte-identical to its pre-task value. ADR-017 clause 6 pairs allowlist inclusion with a schema 1->2 / RenderVersion 2->3 advance and golden regeneration, which the phase plan assigns to task 12.4 and forbids 12.1 from performing. Non-empty allowlists are included, satisfying the 12.1 acceptance criterion. The changelog correctly cites 'ADR-017 clause 6 first half' for this reason.
evidence: docs/decisions.md ADR-017 clause 6 (first half = fingerprint inclusion; second half = version advance/goldens)

acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlist_is_bounded: MET. BadgeSelectorConfiguration.AllowedValues is validated in RendererConfiguration.Validate against BadgeDefinition.MaximumAllowedValues (32) and MaximumAllowedValueLength (64), and the resolved BadgeDefinition enforces the same bounds (throws ArgumentException). Tests: ValidatorRejectsTooManyAllowedValues, ValidatorRejectsTooLongAllowedValue, DefinitionRejectsUnusableAllowedValues.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlist_validated_at_configuration_loa: MET. RendererConfiguration.Validate calls ValidateAllowedValues per selector; PluginConfigurationValidator rejects invalid configs and ConfigurationSnapshotService.TryReplace retains the last valid snapshot (test: SnapshotServiceRetainsLastValidRendererConfigurationOnInvalidAllowlist). Rules verified in source: trim, blank rejected, control chars rejected, case-insensitive duplicates rejected.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlist_secret_free: MET. Error messages contain only the selector enum name and numeric constants, never the configured value (test: AllowedValuesValidationMessagesAreSecretFree; source inspection of all six message strings).
acceptance_criteria_assessment.fingerprint_changes_when_allowlist_chang: MET. Non-empty resolved allowlists are appended to the fingerprint with case/order normalization (test: RendererFingerprintIsSensitiveToAllowedValuesAndNormalizesCaseAndOrder). Empty allowlist is deliberately identity-neutral (12.1-F3).
acceptance_criteria_assessment.scope_no_filtering_behavior: MET. AllowedValues is referenced only in BadgeSelectorConfiguration, RendererConfiguration.Validate, RendererConfigurationFingerprint, RendererConfigurationResolver, config.html, and BadgeDefinition; no allowlist logic in BadgeSelectorResolver/BadgeDefinitionResolver/BadgeLayoutEngine.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.scope_no_size_position: MET. No BadgePosition/BadgeSize or layout-engine change in the diff.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.scope_no_version_or_golden_changes: MET. RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion = 1, RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion = 2, and tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/ is unmodified (git status clean).
